fields.Name: Skip ICF - Advocacy Actions by Kind and Year
fields.Description: Grassroots advocacy activity from MoreCheese: Advocacy Actions by Kind and year, with topic drill-down.

InputDefinition.userMessage: Show me our advocacy activity over time: a stacked area or bar chart of advocacy actions per year by kind (letters, petition signatures, coalition meetings, testimony). When I click a year, show the breakdown by policy topic, and then let me see the members behind a topic. [NO CHAT]

judgeValidationCriteria: Response includes a stacked chart of advocacy actions per year by Kind
Uses MoreCheese: Advocacy Actions (Kind, ActionDate, Topic)
Kinds include LetterCampaign (largest), PetitionSignature, CoalitionMeeting and Testimony
Clicking a year shows a breakdown by topic (e.g. Raw-milk aging rules, Interstate cheese shipment, Dairy pricing reform)
Drilling into a topic shows the members who took those actions, and rows can open the member/person record
